name: MMBench-V1.1
intro: MMBench-V1.1 是 Qwen3-VL、Qwen2.5-Omni 等报告使用的 MMBench 版本，用于通用视觉问答能力评测。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 三级能力体系, 志愿者多源收集, 双路质量过滤, CircularEval
eval_feature: CircularEval, 选项抽取, 视觉问答
scale: 3,217道题, 20个细粒度能力, 开发/测试=4:6
build_method_en: Three-level ability taxonomy, volunteer multi-source collection, dual quality filtering, CircularEval
intro_en: MMBench-V1.1 is a MMBench version used by reports such as Qwen3-VL and Qwen2.5-Omni for general visual question-answering evaluation.
drawio_review_note: Mapped to arXiv:2307.06281 Sections 3-5 because MMBench-V1.1 has no separate paper in the site contract. The diagram retains the complete MMBench construction and evaluation process: three-level taxonomy, 10-20 seed MCQs per leaf ability, volunteer expansion, complementary text-only and all-VLM-wrong manual checks, 3,217 image MCQs, 4:6 dev/test split, heuristic then GPT-4-0125 choice extraction, and all-pass CircularEval accuracy.
